code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer), and a prolonged INR. There is also mild hypoproteinemia and low glucose. These findings suggest a severe systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or sepsis, with evidence of coagulopathy and hypoxemia. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
